ownership.gpl: flight-net owns shared replica adoption/PRIMARY input construction and existing stdio transport; native scene owns host deadline/input/presentation publication; Bevy retains its Resource/HUD wrappers

contract.entry: --server-flight [--server EXECUTABLE] [--server-timeout SECONDS]; incompatible with local --flight, preview, site and manual presentation time
contract.authority: newest validated Snapshot into a client replica; no local integration, resource/scheduler stepping or extrapolation
contract.presentation: existing reader-receive-time interpolation; coherent mesh/body/terrain spin/light/camera publication at the interpolated sample time
contract.instruments: newest authoritative sample; omitted until the first accepted server snapshot; initial canonical pose stays static while waiting
contract.intent: throttle/engine intent separate from acknowledgements; SAS/stick/control mode/part demands retained; ordered part events bounded with two warp/pause votes reserved
contract.startup_presets: queued before GPU startup/pre-stream; not a guarantee that the server was paused before input arrival
contract.server_policy: PRIMARY vehicle, unpaused 1x; server headless runs in wall time including setup/pre-stream, not --flight-step
contract.failure: invalid/backwards sample, command rejection/overflow, observed pipe failure, server flight error or snapshot silence stops the session and kills/reaps its owned child; last complete visual publication retained; server-mode guard prevents local fallback
contract.deadline: native host policy: default 5 seconds, finite 0<seconds<=60 for CLI; handshake timeout and reader-timestamp snapshot silence; minimized windows poll on next draw
contract.snapshot_validation_boundary: kinematics, ephemeris, unit quaternion, throttle and consumed scalar telemetry; parachute loads retain existing checked adoption; not full hostile-server validation or complete resource replication

binaries.baseline_scope: preserved ed57dc2 survey release; subsequent transport-only ancestors did not change its local flight path; local-only A/B, not server cost isolation

reproduction.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1, Vulkan
reproduction.boundary: 1280x720; 600 measured + 30 warmup frames; host input/adoption/presentation/streaming/uploads/classify/raster/HUD/GPU completion; excludes setup/prestream/warmup/final readback; server CPU is concurrent; not GPU-only, isolated network latency or game FPS

regressions: Separate newest replica, client intent and interpolated presentation; frame round-trip error <1e-8 m; body/light/camera use display time
Malformed/backwards snapshots reject before replica mutation; no visual publication on rejection
Live-pipe silence before and after a received snapshot, reader-age rather than polling age, stdout loss, and retained no-fallback guard
Ordered part commands survive acknowledgement, share the protocol bound and stop explicitly on overflow
CLI conflicts and nonfinite bounds reject before scene setup
Actual server adoption and throttle-cut/engine-off acknowledgement with NaN local elapsed to prove the local stepping branch is not entered
Actual native server-backed window lifecycle, plus existing local/survey/GPU regressions

measurements.final_run_policy: six sequential runs after builds and GPU/window tests completed; earlier exploratory runs before the waiting-HUD/early-preset correction are discarded
measurements.local_conclusion: identical final local trajectory/geometry; overlapping median ranges, asynchronous streaming and run-order drift; no speedup or isolated adapter-overhead claim
measurements.server_boundary: different camera/trajectory/completed epoch from local runs and from each other; includes host adoption/presentation, child CPU concurrent; not an equal-workload local/server cost comparison or camera speedup

verification.not_run: existing ignored sim-core and flight-authority wall-clock profiling diagnostics; no new physics or scheduling algorithm

real_server_cpu_smoke.local_elapsed_argument: NaN: server guard bypasses local elapsed validation/stepping; regression requires advancing server snapshots
real_server_cpu_smoke.boundary: functional smoke; concurrent GPU tests/world startup included, not isolated network latency or throughput

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: audio device warnings leave audio unverified; wall-time capture is not a fixed epoch or an equal-scene native/Bevy comparison

limitations: No fleet presentation, prediction/reconciliation, external TCP client, reconnect or joined-worker shutdown guarantee.
Lean Snapshot does not replicate complete resource/structural/electrical state; display loads retain old-pilot approximations.
Server captures have wall-time-dependent epochs and are not matched deterministic local/server image pairs.
Terrain seams/LOD defects, flat sky, PBR/effects/UI parity, conforming persistent GPU bisector topology, FastRT acceleration structures and device-loss recovery remain unresolved.
Captures are implementer diagnostics, not independent blind subjective preference, visual acceptance or complete Bevy displacement.
